description: This Swift source file defines configuration structures and enums for configuring push notification settings, including transport mode, distribution mode, and APNs environment, with methods to read configuration values from app bundle info dictionary.

classes.name: PushBuildConfig
classes.description: A struct representing the configuration for push notifications, including transport, distribution, relay URL, and APNs environment. It has methods to initialize from the app bundle and read configuration values.

methods.name: init(bundle:)
methods.description: Initializer that reads configuration values from the provided Bundle object.

methods.description: Computed property that returns true if the transport mode is relay.
